These systems sometimes run disconnected. Getting consistency and convergence right when the network is unreliable is a central part of the job. Hard distributed-systems problems. Working across engineering, behavioral safety, systems engineering, autonomy, hardware, software, and operations, the Behavioral Safety Manager provides the structure, governance, and visibility needed to deliver safety-critical capabilities from concept through deployment. The role ensures requirements traceability, verification and validation readiness, risk management, and alignment of safety objectives with program milestones, supporting both product delivery and safety assurance objectives. What You’ll Do: Lead planning and execution of safety-critical initiatives across the autonomous vehicle lifecycle, ensuring alignment between product roadmaps, safety goals, and deployment milestones. Establish and maintain traceability between hazards, safety requirements, system requirements, verification activities, validation evidence, and release decisions. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Active Sensors (LiDAR)
jobs.location_raw: Remote, U.S, Ann Arbor, MI, Fort Worth, TX, Blacksburg, VA
jobs.description_text: Meet the team Torc’s Perception teams develop the production machine learning systems that enable our autonomous trucks to understand their surroundings. The Active Sensors team owns the end-to-end lidar perception pipeline, from motion compensation and point-cloud aggregation to multitask learned perception for object detection, road and lane understanding, 3D occupancy estimation for safe vehicle operations. These systems must run in real-time on embedded compute while remaining robust to adverse weather, sensor degradation, and sensor failures. The team works across machine learning, 3D perception, and embedded systems, balancing perception performance and robustness against latency, memory, power and on-board compute budget. As the team’s Engineering Manager, you will lead development across the complete perception lifecycle, from data requirements and pipeline architecture through model training, evaluation, integration, deployment, and robotic testing. You will collaborate closely with teams across sensor hardware, data, infrastructure, simulation, compute platform, systems engineering, safety, perception, and planning. What you'll do: The Perception department is seeking an experienced and technically strong Engineering Manager to lead a machine learning team developing active sensor-based perception capabilities for our autonomous trucks. jobs.location_raw: Remote, U.S, Ann Arbor, MI, Fort Worth, TX, Blacksburg, VA
jobs.description_text: Meet the Team The System Triage team plays a critical role in understanding how Torc's autonomous driving software performs in the real world. Through analysis of vehicle data, system performance indicators, and software quality metrics, the team helps engineering leaders identify trends, investigate complex system behaviors, and make informed decisions as we advance toward production. Within System Triage, the Metrics & Analysis team focuses on turning large volumes of autonomous vehicle data into meaningful engineering insights. From evaluating system performance and traffic law compliance to developing metrics, dashboards, and analysis tools, the team provides visibility into the performance and maturity of our autonomous driving technology. As the Engineering Manager for Metrics & Analysis, you'll lead a team of technical professionals, establish consistent analytical approaches, and help scale the tools and processes that support engineering decision-making. This is an opportunity to remain close to the technical work while shaping how the team operates, develops, and delivers insights across the organization. What you'll do: A successful candidate will have experience in people management, cross-functional collaboration, and hands-on data analysis to support system triage and software quality reporting. The software developed in this role directly enables communication with and command over our vehicles to sense their surroundings, respond intelligently when necessary, and help keep the system operating safely — advancing Torc’s mission to commercialize self-driving trucks for safe, sustained, long-haul innovation in the freight industry. jobs.title: Manager, Social Media
jobs.description_text: About the Role: Tubi is looking for a culturally fluent, highly creative Social Media Manager to help identify and bring to life the unexpected opportunities that keep Tubi at the center of culture and close to our fans. This role will focus on cultural opportunity scouting, fandom and community marketing, and social-led activations. You'll be deeply tapped into what audiences are talking about, watching, sharing, and obsessing over, as well as, identifying the creators, communities, behaviors, and emerging moments where Tubi has a credible reason to participate. Spotting the opportunity is only half the job. We're looking for someone who can turn cultural signals into ideas and then make them happen, whether that's an unexpected creator partnership, a community activation, a quick-turn stunt, an IRL fan moment, or something we haven't tried before.
